lines.en: label soccer15:
scene sky
I show up at the soccer field to see how Miku’s practice is going.
lines.zh: 我出现在足球场，想看看 Miku 的训练进行得怎么样。

lines.en: It's another early day, so I wouldn’t be surprised if it was just her here right now.
lines.zh: 又是个大清早，所以如果这会儿只有她一个人在这儿，我也不意外。

lines.en: I slowly make my way across the school grounds, listening close for the sound of a whistle or...anything to signify that practice is in session-
lines.zh: 我慢慢穿过校园，仔细听着哨声，或者……任何能说明训练正在进行中的动静——

lines.en: : Sensei! Over here!
lines.zh: : 老师！这边！

lines.en: But the noise I hear before anything is Miku's voice, calling out to me before I even know where she is.
lines.zh: 但我最先听到的声音是 Miku 的，我还没弄清她在哪儿，她就先喊起我来了。

lines.en: scene black
scene mikukarin1
: Heya! Come to watch us kick some balls around again?
lines.zh: : 嗨呀！又来看我们踢球啦？

lines.en: : As long as they’re not mine.
lines.zh: : 只要踢的不是我的球就行。

lines.en: : Good morning to you as well, Karin.
lines.zh: : 也祝你早上好，Karin。

lines.en: : Is Miku making you carry her around the field as training or something?
lines.zh: : Miku 这是让你背她绕场走，当成训练还是什么？

lines.en: : That...That wasn’t the plan, but...
lines.zh: : 那……那本来不是计划，不过……

lines.en: : We’re just helpin’ each other stretch so that we’re all loosened up when it comes time for the main event later!
lines.zh: : 我们只是互相帮忙拉伸，这样待会儿正戏开始时大家身体都活动开了！

lines.en: : Is what you're doing really going to loosen Karin up? Shouldn't you...maybe switch positions every thirty seconds or something?
lines.zh: : 你们这样真能让 Karin 活动开吗？是不是该……每三十秒换个姿势什么的？

lines.en: scene mikukarin2
: I think I might be a little too heavy for Miku to carry like this...
lines.zh: : 我觉得对 Miku 来说，我这么背着可能有点太重了……

lines.en: : Karin’s gettin’ plenty loose by bendin' over like this, Sensei!
lines.zh: : Karin 这么弯着腰已经活动得很开了，老师！

lines.en: : Can you say that again, but in a more seductive voice?
lines.zh: : 你能不能再讲一遍，用更撩人的声音？

lines.en: : I've never tried a seductive voice before, so I'm gonna say no!
lines.zh: : 我从来没试过撩人的声音，所以我拒绝！

lines.en: : I guess this is more like strength training for her, though. But hey, if I get a chance to ride a friend, I'm gonna ride a friend.
lines.zh: : 不过这对她来说大概更像力量训练。话又说回来，既然有机会骑朋友，那我当然要骑。

lines.en: : I'm also not sure if this...even counts as strength training since Miku is by far the lightest girl on the team...
lines.zh: : 我也不确定这算不算力量训练，毕竟 Miku 是队里最轻的女生……

lines.en: scene mikukarin3
: Hey! Less talkin’ and more stretchin’! If you lose focus, you’re gonna drop me and I’m gonna break my ankles!
lines.zh: : 喂！少说话多拉伸！你要是分心把我摔下来，我的脚踝就断了！

lines.en: : I need my ankles to do...ankle stuff! Like running and...jumping! And...
lines.zh: : 我的脚踝还要用来做……脚踝的事呢！比如跑步……跳跃！还有……

lines.en: : Ankle stuff!
lines.zh: : 脚踝的事！

lines.en: : I'm going to try and stay quiet so...Miku can keep doing ankle stuff...
lines.zh: : 我尽量不出声吧，这样……Miku 就能继续做脚踝的事……

lines.en: : Miku, you should be nicer to the girl who’s keeping you suspended in mid-air right now.
lines.zh: : Miku，对那个正把你悬在半空的人，你该客气点。

lines.en: scene mikukarin4
: Hey! Who do ya think you’re talkin’ to?! I’m the captain of this ship and if I say starboard you better do whatever the heck that means!
lines.zh: : 嘿！你以为你在跟谁说话？！我是这条船的船长，我要是喊一声「右舷」，你就得照做，管它到底是什么意思！

lines.en: : Isn’t that just a part of the ship?
lines.zh: : 那不就是船上的一个部位吗？

lines.en: : That's it! You're walkin' the plank!
lines.zh: : 够了！你给我走跳板！

lines.en: : Sorry, S...Sensei...Miku is unusually fired up today...
lines.zh: : 抱歉，老……老师……Miku 今天异常亢奋……

lines.en: : Any reason why?
lines.zh: : 有什么原因吗？

lines.en: scene mikukarin5
: Oh! That’s right! I totally forgot to tell ya, but we’re havin’ a full-on practice game between the girls later on.
lines.zh: : 哦！对了！我完全忘了跟你说，待会儿女生之间要打一场正式的练习赛。

lines.en: : We’re probably gonna be here all day so if you wanna stick around and watch, you totally should!
lines.zh: : 我们大概会在这儿待一整天，所以你要是想留下来看，尽管留下来！

lines.en: : Maybe. We'll see how I feel once the afternoon rolls around.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。等到下午看我心情再说。

lines.en: : You really have enough players for a practice game, though?
lines.zh: : 不过你们真有足够的人打练习赛吗？

lines.en: : Well, normally we wouldn’t. But Karin’s on the softball team too, so she pulled some strings and got a few of them to agree to play!
lines.zh: : 平时是不够的。不过 Karin 也在垒球队，所以她走了走关系，说动了几个人来参加！

lines.en: : You’re on two teams at once, Karin? Isn’t that a little tiring?
lines.zh: : 你同时参加两个队，Karin？不累吗？

lines.en: scene mikukarin6
: Oh, no! Not at all!
lines.zh: : 哦，不！一点都不！

lines.en: : I love pretty much all sports, so I figure out how to make it work.
lines.zh: : 几乎所有运动我都喜欢，所以我总能想办法兼顾。

lines.en: : Sure, it can be a little tiring at times...but it's not like there's really anything else I have to do other than studying.
lines.zh: : 当然，有时候是有点累……不过除了学习，我也没什么别的事要做。

lines.en: : Plus, my body was...kind of built for stuff like this, so it’s a lot easier on me than it would be on someone like my sister.
lines.zh: : 再说，我这身板……天生就适合干这个，所以对我来说比对我妹妹那样的人轻松多了。

lines.en: : Where is Kirin, by the way? I thought she was gonna show up early too?
lines.zh: : 对了，Kirin 在哪儿？我还以为她也会早点来？

lines.en: scene mikukarin7
: Who even knows? That girl is always doing her own thing.
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢？那丫头向来我行我素。

lines.en: : It’s going to get her into trouble one day, I just know it...
lines.zh: : 她迟早会因为这个惹上麻烦，我敢肯定……

lines.en: : Karin, are you really okay just...continuously balancing Miku like that? You’ve barely moved since I got here.
lines.zh: : Karin，你就这么一直稳稳托着 Miku，真的没事吗？我从来到现在，你几乎没动过。

lines.en: scene mikukarin8
: Oh, right. Miku is on my back. I totally forgot.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。Miku 在我背上。我完全忘了。

lines.en: : Am I...
: Am I really that light?...
lines.zh: : 我真的有那么轻吗？……

lines.en: scene black
Karin arches her back and forces Miku to dismount.
lines.zh: Karin 弓起背，把 Miku 从身上掀了下来。

lines.en: Fortunately, Miku does not fall and her ankles remain intact, ensuring that she will still be able to do {i}ankle stuff{/i} in the near future.
lines.zh: 所幸 Miku 没摔倒，脚踝完好无损，保证她在不久的将来还能继续做{i}脚踝的事{/i}。

lines.en: Whatever that means.
lines.zh: 管它是什么意思。

lines.en: scene mikukarin9
: Sorry Karin, I’d offer to lift you up and stuff, but I’m pretty sure you’d crush me.
lines.zh: : 抱歉啊 Karin，我是想说我也把你举起来什么的，不过我敢肯定你会把我压扁。

lines.en: : I don't weigh {i}that{/i} much...And you can't just {i}only{/i} train cardio, Miku. You need to be training your entire body.
lines.zh: : 我也没{i}那么{/i}重啦……再说你也不能{i}只{/i}练心肺，Miku。你得练全身。

lines.en: scene mikukarin10
: I know, but...You’re just so muscley that there’s no way I’d be able to even get you off the ground! It'd be a lost cause!
lines.zh: : 我知道，可是……你肌肉太多了，我根本不可能把你从地上抬起来！绝对是白费力气！

lines.en: : Didn’t you try to pick me up the other day? I’m bigger than Karin.
lines.zh: : 前几天你不是试过把我抬起来吗？我可比 Karin 大只。

lines.en: scene mikukarin11
: Yeah and how well did that work out? It was more like a backwards bear hug than anything else.
lines.zh: : 是呀，结果怎么样呢？与其说是抬人，不如说是个反向的熊抱。

lines.en: scene mikukarin12
: I’m sure Karin could do it, though! She’s probably even stronger than you, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 不过我敢肯定 Karin 能做到！她说不定比你还壮呢，老师！

lines.en: : You should look at her abs!
lines.zh: : 你该看看她的腹肌！

lines.en: : Karin! Lift up your shirt and show Sensei what you’re working with!
lines.zh: : Karin！把衣服撩起来，让老师看看你的料！

lines.en: scene mikukarin13
: W-w-what?!? N-n-no way!
lines.zh: : 什、什、什么？！？不、不、不可能！

lines.en: : There’s...There's no way I could ever do something like that! Not in a gazillion years! Is gazillion even a number?!
lines.zh: : 我怎么可能做那种事！一亿年都不可能！「一亿年」到底算不算个数啊？！

lines.en: : Would Sensei even {i}want{/i} to see something like that?! Because I sure as heck wouldn't if I was him! No way! Nuh-uh!
lines.zh: : 老师{i}想{/i}看那种东西吗？！换我是他，打死我也不想！不可能！绝对不行！

lines.en: : Not gonna lie, I kind of want to see.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我还挺想看的。

lines.en: scene mikukarin14
: Why?!
lines.zh: : 为什么？！

lines.en: : Also, is it just me or am I really loud right now?!
lines.zh: : 还有，是我错觉吗，我现在声音是不是特别大？！

lines.en: : Hehehe...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿嘿……

lines.en: : This...{i}This{/i}, children...is the scent of love.
lines.zh: : 这……{i}这{/i}，孩子们……就是恋爱的味道。

lines.en: scene mikukarin15
: L-L-L-L-L-LOVE?!?!?
: Miku! W-What are you talking about?!
lines.zh: : Miku！你、你在说什么啊？！

lines.en: : Sensei, as ya can see, Karin ain't very good with boys. She has this thing where whenever she tries to talk to one, she gets all...broken.
lines.zh: : 老师，你也看到了，Karin 很不擅长应付男生。她有个毛病，只要一跟男生说话，整个人就……坏掉了。

lines.en: : Miku! What do you think you’re telling him?! H-H-He doesn’t want to hear-
lines.zh: : Miku！你到底在跟他说什么？！他、他、他才不想听——

lines.en: : Not gonna lie, I kind of want to hear.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我还挺想听的。

lines.en: scene mikukarin16
: Why are you doing this to me?!
lines.zh: : 你为什么要这样对我？！

lines.en: : Do you like watching me suffer?!
lines.zh: : 你就这么喜欢看我受罪吗？！

lines.en: : Of course not. I just think you’re really cute when you get flustered and I’d like to see a little more of that side of you.
lines.zh: : 当然不是。我只是觉得你慌张的样子特别可爱，想多看一点你这一面。

lines.en: scene mikukarin17
: Huh?
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : What did you say?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : What’s-
lines.zh: : 什么——

lines.en: : Where am I?
lines.zh: : 我在哪儿？

lines.en: : Ahh, youth...
lines.zh: : 啊，青春啊……

lines.en: : Sunburn...sweat...hormones running wild...
lines.zh: : 晒伤……汗水……荷尔蒙暴走……

lines.en: : What a time to be alive.
lines.zh: : 活着真好。

lines.en: : Wow, she really {i}is{/i} bad with boys.
lines.zh: : 哇，她{i}真的{/i}很不擅长应付男生。

lines.en: scene mikukarin18
: Duh! Ya think your old pal Miku would lie to ya about something as silly as that?!
lines.zh: : 废话！你以为你的老朋友 Miku 会在这种蠢事上骗你吗？！

lines.en: : We’re brothers in arms, Sensei! We’re gonna take on the world!
lines.zh: : 我们是并肩作战的兄弟，老师！我们要一起征服世界！

lines.en: : What does that have to do with the way Karin handles men?
lines.zh: : 这跟 Karin 应付男生的方式有什么关系？

lines.en: scene mikukarin19
: Idunno. But it’s fun, right? Just look at how her eyes get all squinty whenever she doesn’t know what to say.
lines.zh: : 我哪知道。不过挺好玩的，对吧？你看她每次不知道该说什么，眼睛就眯成那样。

lines.en: : Cute.
lines.zh: : 可爱。

lines.en: scene mikukarin20
: MMMMMMMMMMMMM!!!!!!!
: Wow. This {i}is{/i} actually kind of fun.
lines.zh: : 哇。这{i}确实{/i}还挺好玩的。

lines.en: : What do you think would happen if I touched her?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我要是碰她一下会怎样？

lines.en: : Like I’ve been sayin’! If you become our coach, you could probs even rub those monster-thighs whenever ya want! Doesn’t that get your blood pumpin’?!
lines.zh: : 就像我一直说的！你要是成了我们的教练，大概随时都能摸那双怪物大腿！这还不让你热血沸腾吗？！

lines.en: : Yes. Though, not in a way that is exactly safe or acceptable in the middle of a soccer field.
lines.zh: : 确实。不过以这种方式，在足球场中央可谈不上安全或者得体。

lines.en: : Hm? Whatcha talkin' about?
lines.zh: : 嗯？你在说什么呀？

lines.en: : Nothing. Just don't look down.
lines.zh: : 没什么。别往下看就行。

lines.en: scene mikukarin20r
: Well, of course I'm gonna look down if ya-
lines.zh: : 那、那你要是这么说，我当然会往下看啊——

lines.en: scene mikukarin21
: WOAH! WHAT THE HECK IS GOIN' ON DOWNSTAIRS?!
lines.zh: : 哇哦！下面到底是怎么回事？！

lines.en: : Something that will very likely kill Karin if she breaks out of her trance state.
lines.zh: : 要是 Karin 从恍惚状态里回过神来，这玩意儿很可能会要了她的命。

lines.en: scene mikukarin22
: I suddenly feel...kinda dizzy...
lines.zh: : 我突然觉得……有点晕……

lines.en: : Want me to take you to the nurse's office?
lines.zh: : 要我送你去保健室吗？

lines.en: scene mikukarin23
: To do what?! I ain't goin' anywhere with ya 'til you take the friggin' rocket launcher out of your pants!
lines.zh: : 去干什么？！你要是不先把那个该死的火箭筒从裤子里拿出来，我哪儿都不跟你去！

lines.en: : I can assure you that the last thing you want right now is for me to remove {i}anything{/i} from my pants.
lines.zh: : 我可以保证，现在你最不希望看到的，就是我{i}从裤子里拿出任何东西{/i}。

lines.en: : Or the first. I don't really know with you yet.
lines.zh: : 也可能是最希望看到的。跟你嘛，我还真说不准。

lines.en: scene mikukarin24
: Somehow...gettin' even...dizzier...
lines.zh: : 不知怎么……越来越……晕了……

lines.en: Well, then. This has certainly turned into a strange situation.
lines.zh: 好吧。这下情况可真够奇怪的。

lines.en: : Sensei...will I ever be able to see again?...
lines.zh: : 老师……我还能再看见东西吗？……

lines.en: : We've got the...practice game today and...I've gotta...
lines.zh: : 今天还有……练习赛，我还得……

lines.en: : G-game?...
lines.zh: : 练、练习赛？……

lines.en: : Oh...right...we have a game...
lines.zh: : 哦……对……我们有比赛……

lines.en: : We need to...practice...for the...
lines.zh: : 我们得……为……练习……

lines.en: : For the game...
lines.zh: : 为了比赛……

lines.en: : Karin, open your eyes.
lines.zh: : Karin，睁开眼睛。

lines.en: : I can't...I closed them too tightly and now they are shut forever.
lines.zh: : 我做不到……我闭得太紧，现在永远都睁不开了。

lines.en: : Aren't guns...illegal in Japan, Sensei? Where'd ya...get your hands on one that size?...
lines.zh: : 老师，枪在日本不是违法的吗？你从哪儿……搞到那么大一挺的？……

lines.en: : You know what? I think maybe you two need a little time to recharge.
lines.zh: : 我说，你们两个大概需要一点时间回回血。

lines.en: : To...recharge...
: Y...Yeah...
: Miku...let's go...recharge...
lines.zh: : Miku……我们去……回血吧……

lines.en: : Yeah...Yeah, we've...we've gotta...do the thing...
lines.zh: : 嗯……嗯，我们还得……去办那件事……

lines.en: : That's right. Go do the thing and I'll...
lines.zh: : 没错。去办那件事吧，我呢……

lines.en: scene black
I'll go do something about the cause of all of your problems...
lines.zh: 我去处理一下造成你们这些问题的根源……

lines.en: I leave the two incredibly hormonal soccer team members to their own malfunctioning devices and attempt to get on with my day.
lines.zh: 我把这两个荷尔蒙爆表的足球队员留给她们自己那些出了故障的零件，试图继续我的一天。

lines.en: I just...wind up taking a quick trip to the nearest restroom first.
lines.zh: 只是……我先得赶紧去一趟最近的洗手间。

lines.en: $ soccer15 = True
$ miku_love += 1
{i}Miku’s affection has increased to [miku_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Miku 的好感度提升到了 [miku_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdayafternoon
